title: The Two Noble Kinsmen
author: John Fletcher · William Shakespeare
description: "The Two Noble Kinsmen" by John Fletcher and William Shakespeare is a Jacobean tragicomedy first published in 1634 and believed to have been performed in 1613–1614.
longDescription: Based on Chaucer's "The Knight's Tale," it follows two imprisoned cousins, Palamon and Arcite, whose deep friendship shatters when both fall in love with Princess Emilia from their cell window.

authorInfo.bio: John Fletcher · William Shakespeare (1579–1625) wrote The Two Noble Kinsmen. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
